notes.title: Level 00 Update
notes.notes:
Hi.
After doing some more playability testing on Level 00, I decided that I should redo it. This was the main reason for this update. Here you have the change log:

- Implemented Steam Cloud feature, (which allow you to save your game data to the steam cloud, so you can resume your game from the same point in a different device).
- Fixed the Data Persistence logic, (there was an issue when loading data after finishing the whole game).
- Added the option of start the story mode from the very beginning, and not just to resume it from saved data.
- Added juice to whole UI in general.
- Added StageCleared UI.
- Redid the whole Level 00, changing it's playability: now it's a top-down view with multiple movement directions instead of the behind view.

And last, but not least, I estimate the full release date for ERO Shooter would be on March/April 2021. This date may change, so stay tunned. :)

Cheers!
irisGameDev

notes.title: First Update :D
notes.notes:
Hi. First of all, I want to apologize for the delay, since this update was planned for 9th January. Anyway, here you have ERO Shooter's first Update notes:

About the new Content:
- NEW FEATURE: added a basic Dating System: right after clearing the very first level, a new menu will be loaded so you can choose your favourite officer to date.
- NEW FEATURE: Data Peristence. Now, you don't have to replay all from the very beginning if you close the game: after clearing a level, you'll be able to resume from its subsequent one.
- Added 3 dating cutscenes: one for every waifu.
- Added a new main story cutscene.
- Added a brand new level. It has a different playability to test.
